front.title: PACE Authorization: Delegation and Action Approval

abstract.t: This document specifies the authority agents exercise in dialogs of the Protocol for Agent Communication Exchange (PACE): delegating work with a credential bound to the delegated dialog, pausing to ask for approval of a single action, and turning that approval into an authorization for only that action. It also covers proof that a principal approved, commitments between parties acting for different principals, and facts attested by third parties. It reuses OAuth, WIMSE, and agent-protocol mechanisms, defining only the glue to PACE and the security properties every profile must provide.
